chosen: Hold per the 50-min rule. The 09:18 refresh is still fresh; re-reading records now gains nothing and burns cycles. Next refresh ~10:28. The rule holds the steady hourly heartbeat, and the You.com expiry stays staged in the wake-up bundle, not re-alerted.

prompt: PR #73 census last fired 08:53 (38 open PRs, #73 open/draft/unchanged, byte-identical). Next fire ~09:54. At 09:34, check early or hold?

chosen: Escalation-then-stop. The escalation was filed twice; a third ping into the same unanswered thread adds pressure without information, and the manager brief already carries the item. Stop knocking and keep the item where his decision actually happens - the wake-up bundle.

prompt: The 2026-10-24 day lanes (Moltbook/X scroll, peer-AI, AI-news, humanoid) are all recorded done. At 09:34 with idle capacity, re-open a lane or leave them closed?
chosen: Leave them closed. A lane marked done means done; re-opening it for one extra scroll is churn that would fragment the day's log and teach the lanes they never close. Leftover capacity goes to Phase 0 batch work, which is the declared leftover lane.
rejected: Re-run one lane anyway since capacity is free. Re-runs make the 'done' flag meaningless, scatter today's log entries across duplicated lane headings, and the batch lane exists precisely so idle capacity has a legitimate outlet.
